[INTERNAL:translation-catalog] .\src\lang\qbittorrent_pt_PT.ts:282:        <source>&lt;p&gt;If set, qBittorrent will assume that all files are present for this torrent and that they all match the hashes in the torrent file. The use case for this mode is if a torrent is created and seeded, or if the user already knows that all the files are complete, this is a way to perform only basic file checks and skip initial hash checks.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The piece hash will be checked when it is requested for the first time by a peer. If a hash check fails, all files in this torrent will be rechecked.&lt;/p&gt;</source>
[INTERNAL:translation-catalog] .\src\lang\qbittorrent_pt_PT.ts:628:        <source>&lt;p&gt;If set, qBittorrent will assume that all files are present for this torrent and that they all match the hashes in the torrent file. The use case for this mode is if a torrent is created and seeded, or if the user already knows that all the files are complete, this is a way to perform only basic file checks and skip initial hash checks.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The piece hash will be checked when it is requested for the first time by a peer. [INTERNAL:translation-catalog] .\src\lang\qbittorrent_pl.ts:628:        <source>&lt;p&gt;If set, qBittorrent will assume that all files are present for this torrent and that they all match the hashes in the torrent file. The use case for this mode is if a torrent is created and seeded, or if the user already knows that all the files are complete, this is a way to perform only basic file checks and skip initial hash checks.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;The piece hash will be checked when it is requested for the first time by a peer. If a hash check fails, all files in this torrent will be rechecked.&lt;/p&gt;</source>

## Post-change audit (after rebrand edits)

User-visible qBittorrent text was rebranded in the GUI, installer (all languages), Web UI, Windows/macOS/Linux packaging and the program updater.
Intentionally kept: GPL headers and upstream copyright credits, "based on qBittorrent" credits, About/WebUI copyright credit to The qBittorrent project, thanks/translators/GPL pages, internal class/namespace/file/resource names, translation catalogs, third-party search-plugin repository URL, and the one-time qBittorrent settings import prompt.
